module inventory.reorder
  purpose: Report the products whose stock has fallen below their reorder level.

import std.console
import std.environment
import std.filesystem
import std.filesystem exposing Path
import std.json

public type Product
  purpose: One stocked product with its current stock and reorder threshold.
  has name: Text
  has stock: Integer
  has reorder_level: Integer
  can FromJson
end

public type AppError is one of
  purpose: The ways the reorder report can fail.
  MissingPath
  Unreadable(path: Text)
  BadJson(path: Text)
end

public function low_stock(products: List of Product)
  returns List of Product
  purpose: Keep the products below their reorder level, lowest stock first.
  tags: inventory
  example: low_stock([Product(name: "Bolt", stock: 2, reorder_level: 5), Product(name: "Nut", stock: 9, reorder_level: 5)]) is [Product(name: "Bolt", stock: 2, reorder_level: 5)]

  let low be
    for each product in products
    where product.stock is less than product.reorder_level
    sorted by product.stock
    collect product
  return low
end

public function describe_line(product: Product)
  returns Text
  purpose: Format one product as a single report line.
  tags: inventory
  example: describe_line(Product(name: "Bolt", stock: 2, reorder_level: 5)) is "Bolt: stock 2, reorder level 5"

  return "{product.name}: stock {product.stock}, reorder level {product.reorder_level}"
end

public function main() or fails with AppError
  needs console, filesystem.read, environment
  purpose: Read the products file named by the first argument and print those needing a reorder.

  let arguments be environment.arguments()
  let path_text be arguments.first() otherwise fail with MissingPath
  let path be Path(path_text) otherwise fail with Unreadable(path: path_text)
  let text be filesystem.read_text(path) otherwise fail with Unreadable(path: path_text)
  let products: List of Product be json.parse(text) otherwise fail with BadJson(path: path_text)
  for each product in low_stock(products)
    console.print(describe_line(product))
  end
end
